fusions.name: Lowered Head
fusions.desc: Butts the target for 14 damage, leaves it 12% easier to wound for 5 seconds, and stuns it for 1.2 seconds.

fusions.name: Scree Kick
fusions.desc: Kicks 3 stones loose in a spread, each of which deals 4 rock damage. Its damage rises 8% for each ally near you (max 32%). Holds 4 charges; each use spends one, and each kill restores one.

fusions.name: Hold the Ledge
fusions.desc: Reduces the damage you take by 20% for 10 seconds, and pulls up to 3 enemies within 4 tiles onto you for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Won't Be Moved
fusions.desc: Once your health falls below 30%, you gain a shield worth 25% of your maximum health for 6 seconds. Once every 30 seconds.
